executive_decision.one_paragraph_thesis_en: Gold is trading at $4520, up 0.85%, while the DXY has slipped to 104.28, supporting a bullish backdrop. Pullback entry zones around $4475‑$4450 offer attractive risk‑adjusted opportunities. A tight stop below $4440 limits downside, aiming for a 1:2 reward‑to‑risk ratio. Overall, the setup favors a disciplined buy on pullback.
